title: बान्तवा राईहरूको सुप्तुलुङमा पितृहरूको स्थान र दायित्व {Place and Responsibilities of Ancestors in Suptulung of Bantwa Rai Community}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख बान्तावा राईहरूको आस्थाकेन्द्र सुप्तुलुङमा केन्द्रित छ । सुप्तुलुङ खाना पकाई खाने तीन चुला ढुङ्गाको एकीकृत स्वरूप हो । त्यसअतिरिक्त पितृहरूको निवासस्थल तथा शक्तिको स्रोतकेन्द्र रहेको विश्वास छ । विश्वासअनुसार यिनै सुप्तुलुङमा पितृहरू निवास गर्दै सन्तानको रक्षा गर्ने गर्दछन् । बान्तावा राईहरूको विश्वासमा पितृहरू नै सर्वोच्च शक्ति हुन् । सुप्तुलुङका तीन ढुङ्गाहरू भिन्न तीन शक्तिको प्रतीक मानिन्छन् र त्यही प्रतीकका आधारमा पुजिने र शक्ति आर्जन हुने विश्वास छ । यी तीन शक्तिहरूमा पुरुष शक्ति, महिला शक्ति र समाज प्रतिनिधि शक्ति हुन् । यी तीन शक्तिहरूमा पुरुष प्रतीक शक्ति अन्न, महिला प्रतीक लक्ष्मी र समाज प्रतीक प्रतिष्ठा तथा एकतासँग सम्बन्धित भएको देखिन्छ । यति मात्र होइन सुप्तुलुङमा बस्ने पितृहरूले नयाँ घर र परिवारको नयाँ सदस्यलाई मान्यता दिने, समाजको आवश्यकतालाई महत्त्वका साथ जोड दिई परिवारमा नैतिकता तथा सुब्बेफाब्बे कायम राख्ने भूमिकासमेत निर्वाह गरेको पाइन्छ । यसरी प्रस्तुत लेखमा सुप्तुलुङले पितृसँग अन्तरसम्बन्धित भई सन्तानका लागि त्रिआयामिक दायित्व निर्वाह गरेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present article is centered on the Suptulung, the center of faith of the Bantawa Rai. Suptulung is the unified form of the three hearth stones on which food is cooked and eaten. Besides that, there is a belief that it is the dwelling place of the ancestors and the source center of power. According to belief, the ancestors reside in this very Suptulung and protect their descendants. In the belief of the Bantawa Rai, the ancestors are the supreme power. The three stones of the Suptulung are regarded as symbols of three distinct powers, and there is a belief that they are worshipped and power is acquired on the basis of that symbol. These three powers are male power, female power and social representative power. Among these three powers, the male symbolic power is related to grain, the female symbolic power to Lakshmi, and the social symbolic power to prestige and unity. Not only this, it is found that the ancestors residing in the Suptulung also perform the role of granting recognition to a new house and new members of the family, emphasizing the needs of society, and maintaining morality and well-being within the family. Thus, in the present article, the conclusion is drawn that the Suptulung, being interrelated with the ancestors, discharges a three-dimensional responsibility for the descendants.

informal_english: The article's really about the Suptulung, the heart of faith for the Bantawa Rai. The Suptulung is basically the three hearth stones you cook and eat on, all in one. On top of that, folk believe it's where the ancestors live and where their power comes from. The belief is the ancestors stay right there in the Suptulung and look after their descendants. For the Bantawa Rai, the ancestors are the top power, full stop. The three stones stand for three different powers, and folk believe you worship them and gain power through that. Those three are male power, female power and social representative power. Of those, the male one ties to grain, the female one to Lakshmi, and the social one to prestige and unity. And it's not just that — the ancestors in the Suptulung are also seen to recognise a new house and new family members, put weight on what society needs, and keep morality and well-being going in the family. So the article's conclusion is that the Suptulung, tied up with the ancestors, carries a three-dimensional responsibility for the descendants.
